exposure: minimised radiographic imaging in pregnant trauma patients
outcome: incidence of delayed diagnosis of injury
cohort: 83 pregnant patients involved in blunt trauma and 167 non-pregnant patients matched for age and ISS from an urban level 1 trauma center.
finding: Pregnant trauma patients received significantly fewer radiographic images upon presentation than non-pregnant patients, but this did not result in a significant difference in the incidence of delayed injury diagnosis.
